This doesn't account for millions of other Americans who experience varying degrees of trouble sleeping and its ripple effects on their daily lives.

Our approach provides a simple, effective way to expand your product offerings and grow your business with minimal overhead and hassle.

Why Private Label Sleep Supplements Are A Strategic Choice

Buying trends and private label supplement reviews clearly show that sleep support products comprise a significant portion of people's needs and wants. As a practitioner or business owner in the supplement industry, offering effective and well-researched sleep supplements is a true win-win for you and your customers. Your business stands to see significant growth, and your buyers support their body's natural ability to maintain healthy sleep patterns and rest.* Praxera sleep formulations make it simple to offer clean, time-tested products that align with today's wellness trends and naturally build a loyal customer base.

5 Top-Selling Private Label Sleep Supplements For Your Business

If you're interested in expanding your sleep product offerings but wondering which are the best private-label supplements to start with, consider these five leading formulations that support general sleep health and wellbeing.* 

1. Melatonin 

Melatonin is referred to as the sleep hormone and helps normalize the body's sleep-wake cycle, supporting the maintenance of normal sleep patterns.* This product is especially effective for those who work night shifts or struggle with other circadian rhythm challenges.*

2. Valerian Root 

The sleep-supportive herb valerian root is known for its calming properties and has been traditionally used to promote increased sleep quality for centuries.*

3. Magnesium Glycinate 

Magnesium plays hundreds of roles in the human body, but magnesium glycinate specifically is a form that has been shown to be particularly supportive of muscle and nervous system relaxation, which are both important for better sleep.* Tri-Mag 300 offers three types of chelated magnesium for nerve function, bone health, and adrenal balance.*

4. L-Theanine 

Green tea is high in the amino acid L-Theanine, known to promote relaxation without unpleasant sedative side effects.* Many consumers seek this out for general calming of the mind and supporting mental ease before bedtime.*

5. 5-HTP 

A precursor to serotonin, 5-HTP helps support balanced mood and relaxation, which in turn can contribute to better sleep quality and more consistent rest.*
